newsitem.title: USA: Roadhouse Grill crops IPO size by almost half.
newsitem.headline: Roadhouse Grill crops IPO size by almost half.

text.p: Roadhouse Grill Inc has slashed the size of its planned initial public offering by almost half, cutting both the number of shares to be offered as well as the estimated pricing range.

The company filed an amendment with the Securities and Exchange Commission changing the terms to an offering of 2.0 million shares in an estimated price range of $6 to $8 a share, making the deal worth roughly $14.0 million. In an October filing, the Fort Lauderdale, Florida company planned an offering of 2.5 million shares to price between $9 and $11 each, worth about $25 million.
Roadhouse Grill owns and operates 30 and franchises or licenses six full-service casual dining restaurants under the name "Roadhouse Grill".
